detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

A Node2Shell gotcha if you track images by tag: once node:24 is republished on 24.22.1, pods started before the rebuild keep running the old binary under the same name.

25.x, 20.x and older lines get no upstream fix. 22.x reaches end of life April 30, 2027.

Finding stale digests in running clusters and blocking new builds that match CVE-2026-111497:
https://anchore.com/blog/node2shell-your-sboms-already-know-which-nodejs-builds-youre-running/ 

#Nodejs #Kubernetes #CVE #SBOM
